question.text: Which of the above could be the graph of $y=\sqrt{x}?$
question.choice5: None of the given functions is the graph of $y=\sqrt{x}$
question.explanation:
Let's recall some of the basic properties of $y=\sqrt x.$

  • The point $(0,0)$ lies on the graph

  • Its domain is $x\in [0,\infty)$

  • Its range is $y\in [0,\infty)$

  • The function is increasing over its entire domain.

  • As $x \rightarrow \infty$, we have $y\rightarrow \infty,$ though it does so slowly

Of the given options, only graph II has all of the above properties. Therefore, the correct answer is "II only."
